name: Constant Elevation
label: Revelation
lede: Sammy Siegler filled in for The Movielife on a European tour around 2002, wrote his first full songs sixteen years later on a tiny acoustic signed by Shawn Mendes, and called Vinnie Caruana to scream them in a converted stone church.

eras.title: A fill-in gig
eras.text: Sammy Siegler had drummed for Youth of Today, Judge, CIV and Rival Schools. Sitting in with The Movielife introduced him to the voice he'd come back for.

years.h: Sammy Siegler drums for The Movielife in Europe
years.p: Siegler fills in on a Movielife European tour and comes away a fan of singer [[Vinnie Caruana|5b1ed841-450e-49b6-8bf3-b50bd54bc897]]'s voice and songwriting.

eras.title: Songs from a Shawn Mendes guitar
eras.text: Sixteen years later, Siegler finally wrote songs of his own and brought them to Caruana. The band was built to live in New York, even though its drummer lived in Los Angeles.

q: For this, I started with a miniature Taylor acoustic autographed by Shawn Mendes
years.h: Constant Elevation record in a 100-year-old stone church
years.p: At Barbershop Studios, a converted church near Lake Hopatcong, New Jersey, with Brett Romnes. Vinnie Caruana loses his voice five minutes into tracking and has to finish vocals another day.
years.xp: The demos had help from [[Alex Barreto|9e81a640-5c20-444e-9064-d2d65cf87328]] of [[Chain of Strength|81a3c11e-ac20-4bb4-8614-06b157e802d8]], [[Andrew Kline|e47911a6-1197-4b29-8ff1-5d7a3a21dc2c]] of [[Strife|5e911223-4228-4a14-8f6c-7d2dfeb62530]] and Joe Garlipp of Despair, Siegler's bandmates in [[World Be Free|87061322-24d2-4ba9-8f25-455a44d0e354]]. Caruana says his other projects lean negative; this one didn't.

years.h: Constant Elevation's first show is in a Brooklyn watch store
years.p: Constant Elevation debut at Throne, a watch shop in Brooklyn, then play Trans-Pecos on September 7 with Luxe, Worn and Steel Cage.
Three songs in about seven minutes: Fuck Runnin', Mouth in Motion and Fletch. Punknews called it the rawest Vinnie Caruana had sounded in years.
years.xp: CoreTex Records in Berlin sold 150 copies on opaque green vinyl alongside Revelation's pressing.

eras.title: Freedom Beach
eras.text: The studio project became a four-piece, pulling in players from Caspian and I Am the Avalanche.

years.p: Bassist Jani Zubkovs and guitarist Mike Ireland of Pass Away join. Recorded with Jon Markson at Savaria Studios in Brooklyn; four songs, including KRS Two and Bob X. Cursion.

sources.title: No Echo: Constant Elevation, Sammy Siegler & Vinnie Caruana join forces
